name: 克里斯托弗·塞德尼奥
name_full: 克里斯托弗·塞德尼奥 Christopher Cedeño

last_movies.title: 神探特伦特 第四季

introduction: Christopher Cedeño is a Puerto Rican actor trained at the Stella Adler Conservatory in Los Angeles, where he studied for four years. His television credits include Westworld, Rake, and Will Trent (2025), as well as a nationally aired Toyota commercial. On stage, he appeared in the award-winning production Anna in the Tropics at the Open Fist Theatre Company.In film, Cedeño starred in Culpa de los Cerdos, earning Best Actor at the 48 Hour Film Project in 2024. The short film later received two Suncoast Regional Emmy Awards for Best Editing and Best Cinematography in 2025, and was an Official Selection in 2025 at the International Puerto Rican Heritage Film Festival and the Puerto Rico Film Festival. He also starred in the short film Al Son Que Me Toquen, Bailo, an Official Selection in 2025 at the International Puerto Rican Heritage Film Festival and the New York Latino Film Festival.Most recently, he completed filming on Lente Fijo, which wrapped production in July 2025, and is set to appear in the theater production Mi Cena Con Luisa Capetillo in March 2026.
